Fig. 2. Figure (a) presents the number of edges in the Steam game network. Figures (b) and (c) show the average Euclidean distance and cosine similarity of game description embeddings, respectively. These descriptions are generated using a large language model (LLM), and embeddings are obtained via an embedding model. The main diagonal elements reflect the Steam game network based on raw connections, while other elements are based on strict connections.
